## Checklist

- [ ] The entry follows the list format: `- [Name](https://example.com/) - Short, factual description.`
- [ ] I checked that the resource is not already listed.
- [ ] I added or changed one resource per pull request when possible, with no unrelated changes.
- [ ] The resource is in the most relevant section.
- [ ] The description is short, factual, and neutral.
- [ ] The link is canonical, public, works, and does not contain tracking parameters.
- [ ] I marked the status when relevant: `__(Archived)__`, `__(Experimental)__`, or `__(Research)__`.
- [ ] This repository is the appropriate list for this resource. If the resource belongs to a sibling list, I linked that repository instead of duplicating the entry here.
- [ ] I ran `make lint` locally when possible.
